caption: The drawing depicts a single object, a hand-crank style pepper grinder or mill, centered within a rectangular border on a plain background. The grinder consists of a glass or transparent central body with gentle curves, flanked and capped by metallic or metal-like bands at the top and bottom, which are rendered with a grayish, silvery tone. The base is wide and rounded, tapering slightly before expanding into the bulbous shape of the main body. The top of the grinder has a domed metallic cap, with a horizontally extending crank handle on the right side; the handle appears metallic with a knob or finial at the end in a lighter color, suggesting it is made of wood or a different material. Below the grinder, the words "ACTUAL SIZE" are written in pencil, and the bottom right of the image bears the name "A. CAMILLI." The drawing uses subtle and muted hues, mainly shades of gray, silvery blue, and transparent tones to portray the materials, with minimal shading emphasizing the object’s three-dimensional form.
title: Pepper Grinder
